read_file.desc: Read one file as text, with optional line ranges or byte caps. Text is returned as UTF-8 with invalid bytes replaced; binary files return a compact summary unless include_base64=true. For large files, prefer head/tail, ranges, or start_line/end_line over reading the whole file; the 256 KB default can consume tens of thousands of tokens.

params.start_line: First line to read, 1-indexed. Used when ranges/head/tail are not set.
params.end_line: Last line to read, inclusive. If omitted with start_line, reads through the end of the file.
params.max_bytes: Maximum bytes to return for this read. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Non-positive values keep the default. Keep in mind that 256 KB of text can consume tens of thousands of tokens.
params.include_base64: For binary files, include capped base64 bytes in addition to metadata. Default: false.
params.head: Return only the first N lines. Takes precedence over start_line/end_line.
params.tail: Return only the last N lines. When combined with head, returns the last N lines of the head window.
params.show_line_numbers: Prefix text output lines with line numbers. Default: false.
params.ranges: Array of [start_line, end_line] pairs for several non-contiguous snippets. Takes precedence over head/tail/start_line/end_line.

write_file.desc: Create or fully overwrite a file atomically, creating parent directories by default and preserving existing file permissions when overwriting. Prefer edit_file for targeted changes. Full diffs are returned only when show_diff=true is explicitly requested.

params.content: Complete file content to write. Provide an explicit empty string to create an empty file.
params.create_dirs: Create missing parent directories before writing. Default: true.
params.show_diff: Include a unified diff. Default: false. If true and the old file cannot be read, the tool errors.
params.max_diff_bytes: Maximum diff bytes to return. Default: 262144 (256 KB); set 0 for unlimited. Negative values use the default.

append_to_file.desc: Append text to a file, creating the file and parent directories if needed. Use only for additive writes; use edit_file or write_file when existing content must change.

params.content: Content to append. Provide an explicit empty string if intentionally appending nothing.
params.ensure_leading_newline: Insert a separating newline before the appended content when the existing file is non-empty and does not already end with a newline. Default: false.

edit_file.desc: Surgically replace text in one existing text file and return a focused diff. Supports exact text or Go regex, single-edit mode or edits[] batch mode, dry runs, CRLF preservation, and a near-miss hint when a single exact pattern is not found. Binary files are rejected and large files are guarded by max_file_size.

params.path: Path to the existing file to edit.
params.old_str: Text or Go regex to replace in single-edit mode. Add enough surrounding context to identify the intended occurrence.
params.new_str: Replacement text for single-edit mode. May be an empty string to delete the match.
params.use_regex: Treat old_str as a Go regular expression. Default: false. Regex replacements may use $1/$2 style captures.
params.replace_all: Replace every match. Default: false, which replaces only the first match; prefer unique context when changing one occurrence.
params.dry_run: Preview the replacement and diff without writing the file. Default: false.
params.context_lines: Context lines in the returned diff. Default: 3; maximum: 50.
params.max_diff_bytes: Maximum diff bytes to return. Default: 262144 (256 KB); set 0 for unlimited. Negative values use the default.
params.max_file_size: Maximum size for the target file before edit_file refuses to load it. Default: 10485760 (10 MB); set 0 for unlimited. Negative values use the default.
params.edits: Batch mode: array of {old_str, new_str, use_regex?, replace_all?} edits applied sequentially to the same file. Top-level dry_run/context/max_diff settings still apply.

delete_file.desc: Delete a single non-directory filesystem entry irreversibly. Directories are rejected.

params.path: Path to the file or symlink to delete.

copy_file.desc: Copy one file or one directory tree to a destination path, creating parent directories and preserving source permissions. Directory copies are recursive, reject symlinks inside the tree, and refuse destinations nested inside the source. Existing destination paths require overwrite=true.

params.destination: Destination path. Files require a file path; directories require a directory path or a new destination.
params.overwrite: Replace destination if it already exists. Default: false.

move_file.desc: Move or rename a file or directory. Same-filesystem moves use rename; cross-device fallback copies then deletes the source when needed. Existing destinations require overwrite=true.

params.source: Source path to move or rename.
params.overwrite: Replace destination if it already exists. Default: false. Treat true as destructive.

get_file_info.desc: Return metadata for one file, directory, or symlink: type, size, mode, modified time, symlink target, and optional line count for text files. Use before targeted reads in large files or when deciding whether a path is safe to modify.

params.output_mode: "compact" (default) returns one line; "details" returns expanded labeled fields including absolute path.
params.count_lines: Count lines for text files. Default: false; set true only when the line count is actually needed.

path_exists.desc: Cheap existence/type check for one path. Returns false for missing paths; returns type and size for files, directories, and symlinks. Prefer over read_file/get_file_info when you only need to branch on existence.

diff_files.desc: Compare two text files and return a unified diff with size and modified-time headers. Binary files are refused and large files are guarded by max_file_bytes. Use instead of shell diff for cross-platform behavior.

params.context_lines: Context lines around each diff hunk. Default: 3; negative values become 0.
params.max_file_bytes: Maximum size for each input file before refusing to diff. Default: 2097152 (2 MB); set 0 for unlimited.
params.max_diff_bytes: Maximum diff bytes to return. Default: 262144 (256 KB); set 0 for unlimited.

calculate_checksum.desc: Calculate checksums for one or more files. Use to verify identity, integrity, or post-copy results without shelling out to platform-specific checksum commands.

params.paths: Array of file paths to hash.

create_symlink.desc: Create a symbolic link. The target path is not prevalidated, so dangling links are possible. On Windows this may require Developer Mode or elevated privileges.

params.source: Target path the symlink should point to.
params.link: Path of the symlink to create.

compress_files.desc: Create a zip or tar.gz archive from files/directories. Each input is stored by basename with descendants under it; empty directories are skipped. Output parent directories are created and the output path cannot be one of the inputs.

params.paths: Files or directories to include in the archive.
params.output: Archive path to create, such as backup.zip or archive.tar.gz.
params.format: Archive format: "zip" or "tar.gz". Defaults to detection from output extension (.zip, .tar.gz, or .tgz).

extract_archive.desc: Extract a zip or tar.gz archive to a directory, creating the output directory if needed. Entries are path-traversal protected so archive contents cannot escape the output directory.

params.archive: Archive file path (.zip, .tar.gz, or .tgz unless format is provided).
params.output: Directory to extract into. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.format: Archive format: "zip" or "tar.gz". Defaults to detection from archive extension.
